summary: The product keeps only the Microsoft Graph permissions it needs.

new.title: Unneeded permissions are removed
new.text: The next install run removes a Microsoft Graph permission the product no longer needs, and checks the result. Getting started shows a step that names any extra permission.

fixes.title: Guides describe today's identities
fixes.text: The security pack and the hybrid worker guide now describe the product's identities as they are today.
